answer: Sybil resistance follows from binding recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments to a ferrous ledger state, so a cloned agent must forge a chain of proof-of-delay attestations. Each layer's zk-STARK compresses prior jade attestations without revealing keys, making an information-theoretic identity indistinguishable unless the forger inverts a collision-resistant hash, breaks the VRF, or waits longer than the sequential delay bound.
